reason: I already give away free meals to creators every week and have no idea if any of it brings people in, so a free tool that counts customers per post is worth two minutes to try. I'd sign up and push the next few DM creators through the coupon link instead of just handing out food.
objection: Will good creators actually be on it, or just the same freebie-hunters already flooding my DMs? And my counter staff are busy, I'm not sure they'll bother tapping a PIN for every coupon during rush hour.
would_change_my_mind: If after a month the only creators showing interest are tiny accounts with fake-looking views, or the coupon redemptions show zero customers, I'd stop using it.
